name: wanguoji
description: An autonomous alternate-history sandbox where nations, dynasties and empires rise, fall and write their own history.

scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm desktop:compile && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-dev-server=http://localhost:5173"
scripts.desktop:dev:debug: pnpm desktop:compile && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-dev-server=http://localhost:5173 --wanguoji-debug"
scripts.desktop:dev:debug:plain: pnpm desktop:compile && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-dev-server=http://localhost:5173 --wanguoji-debug --wanguoji-avatar-renderer=plain"
scripts.desktop:dev:debug:png: pnpm desktop:compile && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-dev-server=http://localhost:5173 --wanguoji-texture-probe=png"
scripts.desktop:renderer-build: tsc && vite build --mode desktop && node scripts/verify-desktop-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-music-build.mjs
scripts.desktop:renderer-debug-build: tsc && node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --mode desktop-debug --sourcemap && node scripts/verify-desktop-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-debug-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-music-build.mjs
scripts.desktop:start:debug: pnpm desktop:renderer-debug-build && pnpm desktop:compile && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-debug
scripts.desktop:start:debug:plain: pnpm desktop:renderer-debug-build && pnpm desktop:compile && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-debug --wanguoji-avatar-renderer=plain
scripts.desktop:start:debug:png: pnpm desktop:renderer-debug-build && pnpm desktop:compile && electron desktop/dist/main.js --wanguoji-texture-probe=png
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: node scripts/assert-packaging-platform.mjs darwin && pnpm desktop:build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.desktop:dist:win: node scripts/assert-packaging-platform.mjs win32 && pnpm desktop:build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.ci: yarn global add pnpm && pnpm install && pnpm build
